_source: Measured by hand on the owner's Korean client screenshots, 1920×1009 windowed (M91 shop set, M95 run set, local-fixtures/, not committed). Regions are fractions of the captured client area: x, y, width, height. Titles are listed in the order a screen wins (popups over the screen behind them) and are read in that order, stopping at the first region that names a screen.

titles._note: fusion confirm line under the slots
full-screen title; the pack picker's 「N층 테마팩 선택」 is found only by the raw pass (M108 bench: 3 shots)
map header 「N층 탐사 중」 over the pack name; brown on red, which the light pass erases (M95, M108 bench: 2 shots)

_fusion: The fusion confirm comes in two shapes, told apart by its 「선택한 기프트 N/M」 header (count): up to five small slots (recipe fusion, 달의 기억 among them; N of them filled, from the left) and exactly three large ones (3/3, keyword fusion). Five: 144px squares from x 228 every 194px at y 358 (M93). Three: measured on the run set's 3/3 confirm (M103).
